meta.temperature_K_convention: Pair is [min_K, max_K]. Use null for max to mean no upper bound. A number always means that number — there is no magic threshold. (999 is still read as no-bound for older files, but is deprecated: write null.)

general.description: A single-species genus known from one system only, HIP 87621, on hot thin-carbon-dioxide worlds with silicate vapour geysers.

meta.summary: A single-species genus known from one system only, HIP 87621.

species.description: Known from HIP 87621 alone (Inner Orion Spur): HIP 87621 2 a (high metal content, hot thin carbon dioxide, 642 K) and HIP 87621 1 (rocky, 698 K), both with minor silicate vapour geysers, and HIP 87621 2 b a (rocky, thin carbon dioxide, 468 K, no volcanism). Sampled like any Odyssey plant, but the game leaves it out of the biological signal count and a DSS never names it.

matchContextNotes: Owner's list name 'Radicoida Unica'; the game's is Ingensradices Unicus, codex key codex_ent_ingensradices_unicus (entry 2460101). Not in EDSM's codex dump or Spansh's genus lists as of 2026-09-27.
Sources: EDAstro codex-data.csv (first logged 2025-11-13, HIP 87621), EDDN bio exports (ScanOrganic Log, Sample, Sample on HIP 87621 2 a, 2026-09-20; CodexEntry on HIP 87621 1, 2026-09-25).

The atmosphere is the known bodies' own; with three bodies it says where it was found, not where it cannot be. The temperature band (600-750 K, from the first two) was dropped 2026-10-03: the EDDN ScanOrganic set logged it on HIP 87621 2 b a at 468 K. The system wall keeps it out of everywhere else.
